name: The Photogenic Studio
description:
We’re a location-based photography team — we don’t have a walk-in studio space. Our shoots are done on location or at the client’s venue.

Capturing life's most precious moments since 1993, The Photogenic Studio by Ajit Rane brings a blend of classic, candid, and cinematic storytelling to every event. Specializing in weddings, corporate events, and celebrations of all kinds, our dedicated team of photographers and videographers serves clients across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Pune. We go beyond traditional photography, offering on-location shoots, video production, and engaging photo booth services to bring your vision to life.

We also provide Photobooth, Birthday Decor, LED, Audio setups service.

featured_reviews.name: Atharva
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m a student from Sir J. J. Institute of Applied Art, and this was my first and last visit to Colo Colors.

I went there at 10:00 AM to print my campaign project and received my prints only at 2:00 PM, an unacceptable delay for basic printing work. Even worse, the staff clearly lacks basic knowledge of professional printing. They had no idea about Indigo sheets, acrylic sheets, and didn’t even have a proper A4-size printer for regular Xerox.

After waiting for hours, while collecting my prints I noticed they had forgotten to print 6 images. On top of that, 1.5 hours after submission, they informed me that their printer wasn’t working and forced me to print on a random textured sheet, completely ruining the output. The print quality was poor, colors were inaccurate, and they don’t even have an RGB printer.

The color values were completely off, and the overall print quality was extremely low. totally unacceptable for anyone working in art, design, or photography.

🛑🛑🛑If you respect your work, whether it’s artwork, photography, or any serious project, do not come here. This place is a waste of time, money, and effort.🛑🛑🛑

featured_reviews.name: yushy (yushy)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Im a photographer from London,
I recently entrusted a film development service in Mumbai with my precious rolls of film, representing months of hard work and creativity during my time working there from London. Unfortunately, the experience has left me bitterly disappointed and infuriated.

These films were not just random snapshots but weeks of hard work. When I handed over my films, I expected professionalism, care, and competence. What I got instead was nothing short of negligence.

To my horror, the developed films were riddled with watermarks, uneven processing, and in some cases, completely ruined frames. with the service giving me a half-hearted explanation about "issues with the film itself or my camera is not working properly"—a claim that felt more like an excuse to cover up their poor handling. The lack of accountability only added to my frustration. I was left with nothing but excuses.

This debacle has cost me irreplaceable creative work and potential opportunities to showcase my project. What stings the most is that I trusted this service with something so irreplaceable, and their carelessness obliterated months of dedication.

For any fellow artists or photographers considering similar services in Mumbai, I strongly urge you to think twice. This experience has been a painful lesson in ensuring your work is only entrusted to those who truly respect the medium and the effort behind it.

I sincerely hope the service takes this feedback seriously, but unfortunately, the damage to my work—and my trust—cannot be undone.

Our pricing was clearly shared by the staff (₹350 per image selection from the requested photo shoot of your child) and agreed upon by you before we started the work. There were no hidden charges, and everything was carried out as discussed.

After you expressed dissatisfaction, we still tried to accommodate your concerns (Sending the entire image  via email, even though this is a service we charge for) by offering a solution at a discounted price, even though it meant a loss for us. We did this in good faith to resolve the situation.

We wish you all the best

featured_reviews.review_text:
1★ Highly disappointed with the service*

We booked them for my brother’s wedding. Engagement was on 24th Dec and the package was around 33k which included photos, cinematic video, and an Instagram reel. We finalized them because their Instagram page looked really good.

The photos were delivered on time, but the editing was very basic – just looked like a filter was added and sent. After continuous follow-up, 2 months after the engagement they provided a poorly edited video and reel. The cinematic video was poorly cut and the quality was very poor. The reel was even worse – completely amateur work, nothing like what they post on their own page.

Worst part is after taking the full 33k upfront, they have been ignoring our calls and WhatsApp messages for the last 4 months. Zero accountability.

We trusted them with our memories and paying 33k for this service was heartbreaking. Don’t go by their social media. Extremely unprofessional team
